$comment: The shape of the grid of a sheet version, format 1 (Functional track FA3, ADR-0173, ADR-0186). One source of truth: the application checks every saved grid against this schema (JSON Schema 2020-12), and the same schema is copied into components.schemas of the OpenAPI document, so the generated TypeScript client has the same types. References are written as #/components/schemas/<Name> for that reason. The schema states the SHAPE only. What a schema cannot say is checked after it by the validator, in a fixed order: the limits that are settings (platform.sheets.limits.*: rows, columns, merges, the length of a text), text without markup or control characters, identifiers that are unique, cells that point at a real row and column and fit their column, styles only on fixed cells, merges inside one zone that never overlap. Nothing an organization writes is ever run as code.

SheetId.description: The stable identifier of a column, a row or a header row. Generated, never typed, never reused inside one sheet; everything that points at a place (cells, merges, later comments and fill-ins) uses it, never a position.

SheetCellRef.description: A cell: the identifier of its row, a colon, the identifier of its column.

SheetGrid.description: The grid of one version: named columns of five types, header rows (a title over merged columns), optionally named body rows, merged cells, and the cells that hold fixed text or a style. Stored sparsely: a body cell that holds nothing is an input cell and is not stored.

formatVersion.description: The format of this document. A document of another number is refused.

dimension.description: 1: columns only, the filler adds the rows. 2: the sheet names the rows.

rowsMode.description: Dimension 1 is REPEATABLE. Dimension 2 is FIXED or FIXED_AND_REPEATABLE.

headerRows.description: Bands above the body under the column labels. Their cells are always fixed text.

cells.description: Sparse: only a cell that holds something or has a style is stored. The key is the row identifier, a colon and the column identifier.

type.description: What a filler may type: text, a number written as digits, a date written year-month-day, one value of a list, or yes or no.

reportable.description: Whether the value of this column is copied, when a fill-in is saved, to the table a report reads. Absent means no.

default.description: The value a new row starts with. It must fit the column type.

picklist.description: The list of a picklist column, kept inside the version so that it is frozen with it.

kind.description: A header cell is always fixed. A body cell that holds a value and has no kind is fixed text; otherwise it is an input cell.

SheetCellStyle.description: Only a fixed cell may carry a style. The size is one of four names and never a number: the page decides what each name looks like.

SheetMerge.description: Two cells, top left and bottom right, inside one zone (header rows or body), never overlapping another merge. Only the top left cell keeps content.
